fixed.interpretation: Descriptive observed timings for this recovery campaign, not isolated microbenchmarks or proof of a speed advantage over other campaigns or implementations.

row_seconds.start: Immediately before evolve(initial, compiled_terms, T=1, steps)
row_seconds.stop: Immediately after evolve returns; before evaluating physical_metrics or writing any NPZ/JSON
includes: Any phase/permutation cache setup performed inside evolve
First invocation in each worker may include Numba compilation/cache startup
excludes: Converting the current exact schedule to compiled terms
row_seconds.comparison_warning: Do not pool directly with optimized campaign row.seconds, whose timer includes state NPZ writing.

preparation_seconds.stop: After all18 base,60 random and4 published schedules and target checks; before writing final verbose design JSON
includes: Intermediate structural-cache JSON writes where applicable
excludes: Writing the final verbose case design JSON
preparation_seconds.development_reuse: Existing exact parent/owned/class graph color orders are read from the already-reviewed identical development designs; class commutators/suffix/BCH orders are rebuilt and matched exactly to archived sequences.
preparation_seconds.positive_scale_reuse: Parent, owned and class graph color orders and class suffix/BCH orders are reused for a coefficient-scaled case only after equality of a fingerprint containing all parent expansions and the consolidated target divided by their common integer gcd. This proves positive proportionality of the exact ordered inputs.
preparation_seconds.graph_seconds_warning: Development graph timing fields do not represent rebuilding all old graphs. A scaled cached case has no fresh graph timer. These are replay/preparation costs, not uncached algorithm complexity measurements.
preparation_seconds.published_seconds: Elapsed loop invoking build_published_schedules and adding all4 returned schedules, including exact target-sum validation and method metadata construction; excludes writing the final design JSON.

resources.partition: One worker for12 non-NH3 cases; one worker for each NH3 coefficient case. The small worker has completed while the two NH3 workers continue.
resources.other_activity: Concurrent optimized-order search, exact native Tranter V2 preparation, published extra propagation and independent verification were running during parts of this campaign. CPU contention and shared filesystem/cache effects were not controlled.
resources.memory_note: Available memory is a contemporaneous observation, not peak resident memory. Prior live observation recorded~0.5GiB smallworker and~1.0GiB each NH3 worker; these are also observations, not measured peaks.

fixed.job_records: job_*.json provide per-worker wall-clock start/finish times; those include imports, input loading, verification, metrics, compression, saving and checkpoint resume overhead. Their intervals overlap, so summing elapsed worker times is not total campaign wall time.
fixed.pre_execution_corrections: The exact archival owned-word alignment and reserialization after initial preparation are documented separately in baseline_alignment.json and are not retroactively added to stored preparation timers.

optimized.scope: Descriptive wall-clock observations from the frozen optimized campaign; not a uniform cross-campaign timing benchmark.

row_seconds.start: After per-case compilation, method term compilation, and budget/step calculation; immediately before constructing/evolving the actual circuit.
includes: Initial/work state allocation performed by evolution
First-use kernel compilation/cache loading when it occurs inside the first call
For Strang: Python pulse-list construction, integer duration/count checks, and conversion to NumPy arrays
np.savez_compressed compression and writing of actual state and Strang pulse arrays
Atomic replacement of the temporary NPZ
Reading and SHA256 hashing the extension design while assembling the row
excludes: Original input/design/state loading and source/import checks
Pauli-term and affine-closure compilation performed before the timed block
Method schedule/term construction outside the budget loop
NPZ state SHA256 (computed later in the row literal)
row_seconds.cross_campaign_warning: Fixed-campaign seconds times evolution only. Do not compare these intervals as identical kernel runtimes.

pair_setup_seconds.includes: Pair-cache construction and distinct-destination rho evaluation.
pair_setup_seconds.excludes: Loading targets, building/sorting unit partitions, constructing the two initial orders, search, circuit execution, and artifact output.
pair_setup_seconds.interpretation: Each group shares one actual setup. Its measured time is repeated in both method reports as an attribute of their shared cache, not as two observed setup costs. The alternative rho=1 mapping for J0 is formed outside this setup timer. A standalone end-to-end invocation of an arm would need its own applicable cache; the observed incremental second arm reuses it.

search_seconds.definition: Sum of the two optimize.search elapsed times stored in per-start checkpoints.
includes: Initial ordered pair-sum amplitudes and positive objective evaluation
Move scanning, integer amplitude updates, contender rescores, complete rescore of selected moves
excludes: Initial-order construction and magnitude sorting in optimize_two
Final checkpoint write after its elapsed value is captured
search_seconds.resume_scope: A resumed search adds elapsed time from completed checkpoints to the new invocation. Uncheckpointed work lost to a crash is not recovered in this number; it is not total operational recovery cost.

optimized.preparation_seconds: Wall time for the current successful prepare(case) invocation; includes setup, all method preparation, checks and report construction before final design writing. Reusing completed checkpoints changes the interval relative to a fresh preparation.
optimized.execution_status_seconds_this_invocation: Time inside run.run_case, including repeated input/plan reading, compilation, all row/state writing and metrics; excludes outer execute.py provenance/import guards. This is a case-level aggregate, not a per-method kernel timing.
optimized.memory: Each process is limited to6GiB address space. execution_status process_peak_rss_KiB is the lifetime peak of that propagation process, possibly including earlier cases, not a per-method allocation or optimizer peak. completion_process_peak_rss_KiB concerns only final aggregation.
optimized.comparability: All new jobs are single-threaded. Concurrent independent jobs, OS scheduling, file compression, cache state, and first-use compilation affect wall time. Evaluation counts and emitted rotation counts are the primary reproducible work measures; wall times are descriptive.

published.measurement: Python time.monotonic wall seconds; single numerical thread per job; concurrent jobs ran in the same WSL instance, so these are descriptive measurements, not controlled cross-method microbenchmarks

includes: Hastings literal and consolidated schedules and internal exact commutation checks
BCH1 exact greedy insertion when requested
initial_four_method_API.interpretation: One joint preparation interval for all four API outputs, repeated in each output metadata; not the individual preparation time of a grouping or Hastings ordering

includes: deterministic RLF and within-clique Christofides tours
extra_four_method_API.interpretation: Joint interval for four extra methods; it cannot be attributed to any one method

includes: load and verify archived design and initial/exact state arrays
case_total.interpretation: Campaign preparation for one case; reading archived exact states is input loading only and no circuit-error values enter ordering selection

includes: parse final native order and accepted insertion history
native_v2.restart_semantics: This field times the latest native process invocation, so a restarted invocation would measure only its remaining work. The recorded production NH3 coefficient scale 1.00 search after WSL recovery is a fresh uninterrupted invocation; all accepted terms are included in its interval. Precrash lost computation is excluded.
native_v2.uniform_scaling_reuse: The positive 5/4 coefficient cases reuse a completed exact order only after normalized integer target equality. metadata.exact_uniform_scaling_reuse identifies these cases, and latest_native_seconds is 0. Their case-total wall time is verification and serialization overhead, not a fresh V2 search. Cubic norm diagnostics are scaled exactly.
native_v2.reporting: Report NH3 coefficient scale 1.00's completed native interval as the fresh large-search runtime. Do not present coefficient scale 1.25 cache reuse as a new native search. For each case the first-order and Strang arms share one ordering preparation and must not double-count its time.

evolution.field: published extra and V2 result row.seconds
first_order_includes: evolve(initial, terms, T=1, steps=r), including any JIT activity reached inside that call
strang_includes: assemble the merged center/boundary pulse list for the chosen r
evolve the assembled pulse list, including any JIT activity reached inside that call
both_exclude: compile full affine closure and per-word representations
convert the ordering schedule into per-word terms
evolution.cross_campaign_limit: Fixed campaign rows time evolution only. Optimized campaign timing includes pulse assembly and compressed state writing. Published first-order rows time evolution only; published Strang rows additionally include pulse assembly. These wall times do not all have identical boundaries and must not be ranked as equivalent end-to-end costs.

published.cost_model: Pauli-rotation counts are exact emitted circuit counts; wall-time intervals do not determine the matched quantum-work budgets
